| [CLAIM-400](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-400.md) v3 | In the meaning–authority model linearized at symmetry, a third, maintained legibility state that authority moves (ε) and that moves interpretation (ν) or endorsement (μ), with persistence λ < 1 and nonnegative couplings, destabilizes the symmetric state exactly when the two-variable condition holds with β + νε/(1 − λ) in place of β and δ + με/(1 − λ) in place of δ: at the threshold the regime is indistinguishable from stronger two-variable couplings, and the slower it is the more it adds, while away from the threshold it adds a mode that no two-variable model has, so a lean in the regime can outlast the advantages it was built from | [QUESTION-253](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-253.md) asked whether authority's effect on what becomes legible as evidence is a third channel with its own instability condition, or [CLAIM-340](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-340.md)'s κ′ renamed. | [CLAIM-409](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-409.md) v2 | For one state law, one intervention distribution and one outcome, a deficiency of sufficiency cannot increase under refinement: if T₁ = g∘T₂ then Γ(T₂) ≤ Γ(T₁); informational closure, by contrast, is monotone in neither direction, since in the three-bit chain of Rosas et al. | [CLAIM-467](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-467.md) v2 | Under full-information, independent audits, a learned allocation of influence among specialists is no better than a contextual router trained on the same audits, which is a mixture of experts whose experts earn responsibility by fitting better; whatever governance adds over routing has to be shown where evaluation fails, and the record has not yet found such a regime | The prediction [CASE-158](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-158.md) states ("Under full information, governance should not beat it") and held by no claim, found in the audit of 2026-10-27; the runs were reported in [CASE-158](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-158.md) and reproduced in [CASE-162](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-162.md), where the router had the lower error in all four cells, selective and captured audits included. | [CLAIM-471](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md) v3 | Physical interconnection can generate effective constraints on joint behaviour; measurement can establish correspondences among local descriptions; and adaptive apparatuses can revise those correspondences; gluing expresses compatibility under specified relations, but neither the relations' physical generation nor their adequacy follows from gluing alone | The owner's U20 of the exchange of 2026-10-27, "interactions generate constraints that manifest as gluing conditions between intertial frames", restated at the owner's review. | [CLAIM-474](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md) v2 | From interconnection to individuation, five relationships are distinct achievements and none implies the next: interconnection fixes what joint behaviour is possible, compatibility which local descriptions admit a coherent whole, dynamics which compatible, frustrated or differentiated organizations persist, individuation which persistent organizations have sufficiently robust identity and boundaries, organizational autonomy being the further question which of those also help maintain their own constitutive constraints, and inquiry which of them can measure and revise their own models and apparatuses under resource bounds; the research program is to find the conditions for each transition | Filed at the owner's review of the pull request, which asked for a synthesis "From Interconnection to Individuation: A Relational Constraint Research Program" that would make the theory "legible as a research program with distinct testable transitions, rather than a cluster of philosophically suggestive analogies". | [CLAIM-478](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md) | Scale separation helps make structure and not only marks it: where some degrees of freedom settle fast relative to others, the relation they settle into is a constraint on the system over the window between the two time scales, so what is a realization at one scale works as a constraint at another; and organization can make new separations in turn, as when modes slow near an instability and become order parameters, so time-scale hierarchies and constraints can produce one another | The owner's, U12 of the exchange of 2026-10-27: "I think we may still have a coverage gap wrt scale separation and how that participates in creating structure". | [CLAIM-480](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) v2 | Composing interactions can turn an interior into a constraint, and sometimes into a constraint of a new kind: in the chain E = ½k₁(x₁ − x₂)² + ½k₂(x₂ − x₃)², with x₂ internal and equilibrated, the boundary sees E_eff = ½·k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂)·(x₁ − x₃)², a coupling between x₁ and x₃ that neither part has; if the interior relaxes slowly, eliminating it leaves a history-dependent constraint, a memory kernel, so interconnection fixes an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories and separation of time scales decides only whether that constraint is approximately memoryless; and for cellular sheaves the reduced constraint can relate three boundary values where every relation among the parts is pairwise | From A22 §4 and A23 §IV of the exchange of 2026-10-27, which called composition "the most important missing mechanism" after the owner's U20. Baez and Fong's black-boxing functor is the general theorem for passive linear networks. The memory case ties it to Mori–Zwanzig and to [CLAIM-478](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md): interconnection yields an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories in every case, and separation of time scales decides only whether it is approximately memoryless. For cellular sheaves the reduction can need a richer relational vocabulary than the parts used (THEORY-1090; QUESTION-283). | [CLAIM-481](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md) | Coupling does not by itself separate time scales: two identical undamped oscillators coupled with stiffness k have normal modes at ω₀ and √(ω₀² + 2k), nearly equal when k ≪ ω₀², and neither decays; separation comes where the coupling dissipates relative differences faster than collective ones, as in ẋ = −ax − k(x − y), ẏ = −ay − k(y − x), whose collective and relative modes relax at rates a and a + 2k, and in a Laplacian flow ẋ = −κLx, where the spectrum of L sets the rates | The answer A20, A21 and A23 gave to the owner's conjecture at U20 that coupling necessarily induces scale separation ([CLAIM-473](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-473.md)). Two small computations: conservative coupling splits modes without separating or damping them, and dissipative coupling damps the relative mode at a rate that grows with the coupling. For a Laplacian flow the kernel is exact compatibility and the nonzero spectrum is the hierarchy of relaxation rates, so a spectral gap is where the separation comes from. Conceded, so Active. It gives a mechanism for [CLAIM-478](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md)'s second half and is not a test of individuality. | Active |
